changes: Entry ID suggestions open only when the dropdown arrow is activated.
Tapping or typing in the ID text box closes the suggestions and keeps manual editing available.
Edit ID and Skip ID start with the dropdown closed; delayed ID checks do not reopen it.
Opening and skipping IDs reuse an encrypted ID suggestion list on this device; typing no longer repeats server lookups.
IDs and receipt conflicts are checked again before capture and before finalizing a Google Drive save, including changes made on another phone.
